p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # extend any diagonal run of repeated non-background color backwards along its axis
    for color in set(sum(g, []))-{5}:
        pts={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color}
        for dr,dc in [(1,1),(1,-1)]:
            for r,c in list(pts):
                if (r-dr,c-dc) in pts: continue
                if (r+dr,c+dc) not in pts: continue
                rr,cc=r-dr,c-dc
                while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==5:
                    g[rr][cc]=color
                    rr-=dr; cc-=dc
    return g
''')
